name: Codex Tools
author: fidzzcodex@codex.io
description: Universal app hosting untuk Pterodactyl: Node.js/Bun/PHP/Python (pilih versi lewat dropdown) plus Go, Rust, C, dan C++ toolchain, browser automation lengkap (Puppeteer, Playwright, puppeteer-real-browser, Camoufox), static site hosting tanpa nulis server, cron job scheduler bawaan (support range/step/list), backup otomatis ke folder + Telegram dengan retensi custom, web terminal, dan Cloudflare Tunnel. Auto-detect runtime dan package manager dari startup command kamu.

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description:
Perintah buat jalanin aplikasi kamu. Otomatis kedetect butuh Node/PHP/Python yang mana.
Contoh: node index.js | npm start | python3 main.py | php artisan serve
Kosongin kalau pakai Static Host Mode di bawah.

variables.name: Static Host Mode
variables.description: true = jalanin server statis bawaan (python http.server), buat host situs HTML/CSS/JS tanpa perlu nulis app sama sekali. Startup Command diabaikan kalau ini true.

variables.name: Static Host Directory
variables.description: Folder (relatif ke /home/container) yang mau di-host kalau Static Host Mode aktif. Upload file HTML kamu ke sini.

variables.name: App Port
variables.description: Port yang di-listen aplikasi kamu (atau Static Host Mode). Samakan dengan port allocation server kamu di tab Network.

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description: Pilih versi Node.js lewat dropdown. 22 = Maintenance LTS, 24 = Active LTS (rekomendasi produksi), 26 = Current. Cuma berlaku kalau Startup Command pakai node/npm/pnpm/yarn/bun.

variables.name: Python Version
variables.description: Pilih versi Python lewat dropdown. Cuma berlaku kalau Startup Command pakai python3.

variables.name: PHP Version
variables.description: Pilih versi PHP lewat dropdown.

variables.name: Package Manager
variables.description: auto = deteksi otomatis dari lockfile (bun.lock/pnpm-lock.yaml/yarn.lock/default npm). Pilih manual kalau mau paksa salah satu. Khusus project Node.js.

variables.name: Auto Build
variables.description: Compile ulang project Go/Rust/C/C++ setiap restart sebelum start command dijalankan (kalau start command pakai binary path seperti ./app_bin).

variables.name: Skip Deps Install
variables.description: Lewati npm/pip/composer/go mod install setiap restart. Aktifkan kalau dependency sudah lengkap dan mau restart lebih cepat.

variables.name: Process Manager (PM2)
variables.description: true = auto-restart aplikasi kamu kalau crash, tanpa restart seluruh container. Node.js pakai PM2, bahasa lain (PHP/Python/dll) pakai Supervisor. Otomatis milih sesuai Startup Command.

variables.name: Headless Mode
variables.description:
true = browser automation (Puppeteer/Playwright) jalan headless, hemat resource.
false = jalan headful lewat Xvfb, rendering lebih mirip browser asli & bypass proteksi lebih kuat, tapi lebih berat.

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description: URL repo Git buat di-clone otomatis pas server start. Kosongin kalau mau upload file manual.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username Git, buat clone repo private. Kosongin kalau repo-nya public.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal Access Token Git, buat clone repo private. Kosongin kalau repo-nya public.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch yang mau di-clone. Kosongin buat pakai branch default repo.

variables.name: Auto Update on Restart
variables.description: true = otomatis git pull tiap kali server di-restart, biar selalu pakai kode terbaru dari repo.

variables.name: User Upload Mode
variables.description: true = skip proses git clone, kamu upload file sendiri lewat File Manager panel.

variables.name: Cron Jobs
variables.description:
Jadwal tugas otomatis, satu baris satu jadwal, format standar cron (menit jam tanggal bulan hari command).
Support: '*', angka pasti, list koma (1,15,30), range (1-5), dan step (*/5 atau 1-30/5).
Contoh: 0 3 * * * curl https://situskamu.com/ping
Dicek tiap 20 detik, bukan system cron daemon (biar aman dari batasan filesystem read-only).

variables.name: Enable Auto Backup
variables.description: true = backup otomatis semua file ke folder .codex/backups sesuai interval di bawah.

variables.name: Backup Interval (Hours)
variables.description: Interval backup otomatis, dalam jam.

variables.name: Backup Retention Count
variables.description: Jumlah backup terakhir yang disimpan di .codex/backups, sisanya otomatis dihapus.

variables.name: Backup Saat Server Stop
variables.description: true = jalanin satu backup ekstra tiap kali server dimatikan lewat panel (butuh Enable Auto Backup = true juga).

variables.name: Backup to Telegram
variables.description: true = tiap backup juga dikirim ke Telegram (selain kesimpen di folder .codex/backups). Butuh Bot Token & Chat ID di bawah.

variables.name: Telegram Bot Token
variables.description: Wajib diisi kalau Backup to Telegram = true. Dapetin dari @BotFather di Telegram.

variables.name: Telegram Chat/User ID
variables.description: Wajib diisi kalau Backup to Telegram = true. Chat ID atau User ID tujuan kirim file backup. Cek lewat @userinfobot di Telegram.

variables.name: Enable Webhook Notifications
variables.description: Isi URL webhook (Discord/Slack/dll) buat dapat notifikasi pas server start dan stop.

variables.name: Webhook Custom Payload
variables.description: Custom JSON payload buat webhook. Placeholder yang bisa dipakai: {event}, {server}, {ip}, {time}. {event} bernilai start atau stop.

variables.name: Enable Web Terminal
variables.description: true = akses terminal langsung dari browser (via ttyd), tanpa perlu buka panel Pterodactyl.

variables.name: Web Terminal Port
variables.description: Port buat akses web terminal.

variables.name: Web Terminal Username
variables.description: Username login web terminal (basic auth).

variables.name: Web Terminal Password
variables.description: WAJIB DIGANTI sebelum expose ke publik. Password login web terminal.

variables.name: Enable Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: true = expose server ke internet lewat Cloudflare Zero Trust Tunnel, tanpa perlu port forwarding manual. Butuh Cloudflare Tunnel Token.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: Token dari Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard > Networks > Tunnels. Wajib diisi kalau Enable Cloudflare Tunnel = true. Rahasiakan token ini!

variables.name: Live Stats Interval
variables.description: Interval (detik) buat nge-print ulang uptime/RAM/disk di console selama container jalan. Set 0 buat matiin.
